anatomy.structure: <Avatar image={{ alt: "Ada Lovelace", src: avatarUrl }} fallback={{ children: "AL" }} />

parts.description: Non-interactive span container that owns the image loading status.
Image element rendered once the image has loaded.
Fallback element rendered while the image loads or after it fails.

slots.name: image
slots.description: Props for the image element (src, alt, srcSet, ...); the image renders once it has loaded.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: Props for the fallback element; children render initials or an icon while the image loads or after it fails.

props.name: image
props.description: Props passed to the image element, such as src, alt, and srcSet.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Props passed to the fallback element; children render the initials or icon.

migration.notes: Styles mapped to En UI theme variables; sizes exposed through the size prop.
